It takes twenty minutes to get to the pedestrian street by bike. Tom and Max had great fun there. Max is interested in singing. Also, families stroll the promenade at dusk.
The weather was windy that day. Tom learned a lot about music. Both of them like soup and tea. Hungry shopping feeds impulse buying.
Tom likes windy days best. There are always many people at the subway station. The pedestrian street is one of the best places in the city. These pans are on sale.
Tom borrowed a book about music from the bookstore. Life is full of small surprises. Tom usually has soup for breakfast.
